papers.title: Beyond Winning: Margin of Victory Relative to Expectation (MOVDA)
papers.key_finding: MOVDA framework reduces Brier score prediction error by 1.54% compared to TrueSkill and improves outcome accuracy by 0.58% on NBA data 2013-2023 (13,619 games)
papers.relevance: CRITICAL — direct Brier reduction on NBA game prediction
papers.actionable_technique: Incorporate winning-margin dynamics as features: margin_vs_expected, margin_volatility_7d, margin_home_advantage. These capture prediction confidence calibration beyond win/loss.
papers.fleet_potential_impact: ~0.003-0.005 Brier reduction on fleet best 0.22019 → target ~0.215

papers.title: Long-Sequence LSTM Modeling for NBA Game Outcome Prediction
papers.authors: Charles Rios, Longzhen Han, Almas Baimagambetov, Nikolaos Polatidis
papers.key_finding: LSTM using 9,840 games (8 seasons) achieved 72.35% accuracy, 73.15% precision, 76.13% AUC-ROC
papers.relevance: MODERATE — incompatible with current GA feature-only approach; 2-stage: LSTM embeddings → XGBoost

papers.title: Graph-based Encoding for NBA Prediction
papers.authors: Junhao Su, David Grimsman, Christopher Archibald
papers.key_finding: Knowledge graphs improve predictive models for NBA forecasting
papers.relevance: LOW for GA islands; interesting for Oracle future work
